segments.ja47:1.3: Hāpeti atthaṃ dummedho, koṇḍañño vāruṇiṃ yathāti.

lines: Tattha koṇḍañño vāruṇiṃ yathāti yathā ayaṃ koṇḍaññanāmako antevāsiko “atthaṃ karissāmī”ti loṇaṃ pakkhipitvā vāruṇiṃ hāpesi parihāpesi vināsesi, evaṃ sabbopi anatthakusalo atthaṃ hāpetīti bodhisatto imāya gāthāya dhammaṃ desesi.
